list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 (names and descriptions as PlayStation publishes them)
note: Guides are written in the author's own words for this entry. Names and descriptions are the official ones; every guide cites its sources. Counts (stunts, vehicles, spots) are as the trophy tracker and PowerPyx report them at launch.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no separate task behind it, no multiplayer requirement and no DLC: the whole list is single-player, and the roadmap in this guide is built so that the last trophy you earn is usually the 100% completion gold or one of the late cleanup feats. Work the stages in order and the platinum takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Follow the roadmap stages 1 to 5 in this guide.
The final trophy is normally A Long Road (100% completion) or a late cleanup trophy.
No online play, no DLC and no second playthrough are needed.

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission of the game, so it cannot be missed: play through Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is the first story trophy most players earn, and it also introduces fishing, which comes back later for the Cal fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story in Chapter 5. This is the second gold trophy in the list and the last story trophy; after the credits the game returns you to free-roam, where everything needed for the 100% checklist and the remaining trophies is still available. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay, and a chapter-start save is the only way back if you want to redo anything.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the gold that usually unlocks last. The 100% checklist only becomes visible after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts. The requirements are far more forgiving than a true 100%: roughly 60% of everything. You need any 100 optional missions (there are far more), any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, and all of the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward it is missable, and it can all be done in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (list cross-checked with Exophase and PSNProfiles)

steps: Finish the story; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist in free-roam: 100 optional missions, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges.
Complete every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest — those need all of them.

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — the 100% checklist wants 300 of them, so this trophy comes on the way. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps with a parachute. Mix them freely; the under-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track progress by region in the Progress menu under Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, where each completed stunt stays marked by name.

steps: Use a fast bike or car and hit stunt jumps, or a plane for under-bridge flights and knife flights.
Under the Bridges (202 of them) is the fastest category to grind.
Check Progress > Activities > Stunts for your count by region.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once. The tracker counts fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race (or race challenge, or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. You can see the list under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, and the map's Activities filter (the blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them. The story introduces most of these on its own, and working on the other trophies will quietly finish the rest — this is one of the easiest trophies in the list.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which of the 9 types you still need.
Try each missing one once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt.
Most of these happen naturally while working on other trophies.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. This is one of the silver trophies the 100% checklist also demands in full, so there is no way around doing every range. The gold medals are not brutally hard — take your time, use a steady weapon, and treat each range as a short score-attack session rather than a race. PowerPyx has a dedicated page listing all 12 locations and the 42 golds if you want to check them off one by one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps: Find the 12 shooting range locations (marked on the map).
Play each range's challenges until you hold a gold medal in all 42.
A steady aim beats speed — replay a challenge as often as needed.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — there are 42 drone races in total across those spots, but one win per location is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy arrives while you are doing that. Drone races are a flying skill check more than a speed check: learn the gates on your first run, then race the line cleanly on the second.

Win at least one race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — any 20 of the 40 unique race locations in the game. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count toward the activity, and the trophy only asks for 20 distinct wins, so pick the races you are comfortable with and skip the ones that fight you. The Top Fun drone races and the street races you meet in the Yago stranger strand are a good place to start.

steps: Pick any 20 of the 40 unique race locations and win each once.
Drone races and street races both count — use whichever you are best at.
Wins must be in 20 different races, not 20 wins in the same one.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you about a fishing challenge and mark a spot on the map with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge. Fishing is a patience mini-game — watch the line tension, reel in steady bursts, and don't let the fish snap the line. The challenge only opens once Cal contacts you, so if it hasn't appeared yet, keep playing the story.

Beat Cal in the fishing challenge he sets.

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home — interact with the controllers there — and the fourth is on arcade machines out in the world. To complete a game you must reach the end of all its levels at least once; you don't need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best and play it through. It is available from Chapter 1.

Pick one of the 4 video games and play it to the end of all its levels.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3. While playing as Lucia you will get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville, which marks the questline on the map. The five quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of her quests are still available after the story, so there is no rush — but do them as Lucia, since the line is hers alone.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

Complete her 5 quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.
All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It gets marked automatically in Chapter 1, and a while after the mission Island Dreams he calls you; he is then marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — dive to the shipwrecks, dig the treasure out of the ocean floor with the metal detector, and bring it back to him. He wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total, in several sets: after the first set he calls you back for more. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1, but he returns in Chapter 2 or 3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees, and Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.

Dive the marked shipwrecks, dig up the treasure with the metal detector, return it to Kenton.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his quest sets; he returns after Chapter 1 if he goes quiet.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline, which gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. The five quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of his quests are still available after the story, so work through them whenever you like — the trophy pops when the last one, Hometown Heroes, is done.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands in the open world. Not every side questline counts — the game only counts certain strangers, and questlines like Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy even though they have their own trophies. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), and more are still being found — the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count. All strangers are still there after the story, so this is a free-roam cleanup trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List questline. It gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in the west of Vice City (green RK icon). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on his list, then drive it back to him — a car delivered in good condition pays more. Some cars he marks for you in fixed locations, often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, but you can also steal them off the street. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

Scan cars with WAiNK first — it tells you if a car is on the list.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is only available as Jason and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finishing it pops the trophy. Everything here is still available after the story.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations in Leonida. Both Lucia and Jason can meditate at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you can track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY IN THE GAME: there is one meditation in Chapter 1 at Jason's house that disappears after Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot like the rest, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy; PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so doing it is the safe move. The final meditation needs both characters together, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so the trophy is stricter than the checklist here.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline. It gets marked at some point after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive the message — the line is Jason-only). After that first quest he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. One clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck — there are 15 target decks, and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy comes naturally on the way. Exactly which animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

Meet Bret in Lummox County (Veteran Hunted) and take his hunting rifle.
Hunt the animals he marks and bring them back to him.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible type, and each set is a group of cards that belongs together — find all the cards of a set to complete it. You only need 3 sets, so pick the sets whose cards you find first and focus on those rather than trying to collect everything. PowerPyx has a dedicated page with all 18 set locations if you want to plan a route instead of stumbling on cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Collect cards as you explore Leonida; each card belongs to one of 18 sets.
Complete any 3 full sets — pick the sets you are closest to finishing.
Use a card-set location guide to plan a route for the last cards.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up on the D-pad to open it instantly, then hold R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are far more than 100 scannable spots, so it does not matter which ones you pick: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags all count. Just scan things as you pass them and the trophy pops long before you run out of spots. WAiNK scanning is also how you check vehicles for Randy's Wish List, so you will be using it constantly anyway.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and look at landmarks, curiosities and sculptures.
Hold R1 to scan each one; any 100 scans count.
Landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. The 100% checklist wants any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there — and since 10 more challenges exist than the checklist needs, you can skip the hardest ones entirely. View and track challenges under Progress, Challenges; the Completed checkmark in the bottom right shows your count when you scroll over one. Most challenges finish naturally while you work on the other trophies; leave this for late, then pick the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Check Progress > Challenges to see what you have already finished.
Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; skip the hardest ones.
This pops automatically while working toward 70 of 80 for 100%.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then break away on a fast sports motorcycle and cut through traffic until you leave the search area; if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it backs off. A reliable escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not the moment you leave the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, when the bank vault robberies hand you 4-star wanted levels for free.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (list cross-checked with Exophase and PSNProfiles)

steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) so you are together.
Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a reliable route.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time. This only opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Hit robbery targets (green icons on the map) while the police are chasing you and stay in the red-and-blue flashing wanted state — don't let it drop to the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and call your partner before you start. Loot a couple of items in each store and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs; if you leave a store before the police arrive, the chain may break, so keep going — if it doesn't pop after the 3rd shop, hit a 4th and keep going until it does. The unlock is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the 3rd shop. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, which open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (list cross-checked with Exophase and PSNProfiles)

steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner so you rob together.
Rob 3 shops in a row (green icons) without losing your wanted level.
If it doesn't pop after the 3rd shop, hit a 4th — the unlock is delayed ~30 seconds.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — the game has 557 at launch across cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes; scanning is enough, you don't need to drive them. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this trophy pops on the way there. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by.
You need 200 scanned for 100%, so this pops early on the way.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. To make it work, buff your focus first — eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the focus time. Then line up 5 enemies close together — the criminals at gang operations are ideal — wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover, and use a full-auto assault rifle like the Duke 556 for accuracy. The trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; check it under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Focus. You will likely reach Focus Level 4 naturally and may earn this without trying.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (list cross-checked with Exophase and PSNProfiles)

steps: Raise Focus to level 4 (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots).
Buff focus with food and Adrenaline before the attempt.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) near 5 grouped gang enemies and drop all 5.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport and fly away with it. It has to be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the planes parked out on the airfield don't count. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to it, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane (you can also walk in through the terminal). Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy is slightly delayed and pops once you are far enough out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Go to VCIA and find the passenger plane docked at terminals E3/E4.
Enter through the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit.
Reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and the trophy pops once you have taken it and started using it. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, get into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks. Expect heavy resistance from the base, so bring body armor and be ready to fight your way in and out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

Enter the base (gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance).
Get into a Rhino tank in the south of the base and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons on the map in unfogged areas. Break into a store through the back door using the Snap Gun (the gadget stays in your inventory permanently; when you approach a locked door you get the choice to kick it, which triggers the alarm, or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun (don't kick the door).
Loot the safe with its code, destroy the security footage, disable the alarm, then leave.

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch a guard carry a briefcase of cash in and the vault open, then go in while it is open and rob it — bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag, since you can't carry all the cash alone. After that quest you can pay Yasmani for tips about security vans ($10,000 each, after his earlier Payday Loans quests); he marks the vans with purple icons, and you follow them to the bank. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so this trophy pops on the way — and each vault pays up to $205,000, making it the best money in the endgame.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The easiest way is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing the vault of a large bank automatically counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank first. You can also do it earlier in free-roam: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes your fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

Or, in free-roam: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door.
Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) for the pop.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every part of the map that still shows black fog until the entire map is visible. A plane covers ground far faster than a car, and you can sweep the state in a few long passes. PowerPyx has a dedicated guide on unfogging the map fast and which plane to use if you want a route instead of wandering.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

Sweep area by area; the map unfogs as you fly over it.
All 52 areas must be revealed for the pop.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; the trophy only needs one per gang, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so this pops on the way there. Operations get marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your count per gang under Progress, Gangs — scroll over a gang and the bottom right shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

Rob at least one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Track per-gang counts under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops once you have the drink in hand with the view in front of you — a short, easy trophy that is best done whenever you are passing through Ocean Beach anyway.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a specific car from a specific showroom and drive it straight through the showroom window. The car is the blue Banshee in the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only take it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window. The trophy pops with a slight delay, after you drive further away down the street. It only unlocks from this blue Banshee, not from any other car — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Before you go, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow open the safe. You visit the alley during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which gets marked automatically. Inside, pick up the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. If you miss one during the mission, don't worry: the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for the remaining valuables — the trophy is not missable and you don't need all 3 in one go.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take the luxury watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe loot.

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, select a character and scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training, so you make double the progress. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are plenty all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. The trophy list itself shows your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right side of the screen. Profiles run from Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes) through Hardened (incapacitating without killing) and Violent (killing enemies and civilians) to Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones) and finally Irredeemable — a permanent status if you keep using excessive violence, so be careful not to push that far. You will very likely get this passively while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it still hasn't popped at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but note that cops shoot on sight more readily at Psycho or Irredeemable profile.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed at launch. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — the idea being that something goes wrong the first time and works the second time, hence the description. Until the community pins it down, the honest advice is: keep playing, visit the Payday Loans store when you can, and watch the trophy tracker; this guide will be updated here once a confirmed method exists. Do not chase this one early — leave it for the cleanup stage.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, and come solo — the event is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn. At the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her and offer to help. She asks you to go back to her car at the roadside — do that and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, talk to the woman it drops, then go back to her car.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: While riding any motorcycle or push bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are packed together — ride slowly through a crowd and kick as you pass. The counter is 10 kicks inside one minute, so keep moving and don't stop between kicks. Wanted attention will follow, but the trophy pops before the police become a real problem.

Kick pedestrians with Square while riding — 10 kicks within 60 seconds.
Keep moving through the crowd; don't stop between kicks.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores, take the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most — and the total counts across all robberies, so you don't need $250,000 at once. This comes naturally while doing all the robberies for the 100% checklist; a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000, though vaults only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

Rob banks and Payday Loans stores for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 total to a fence (Yasmani pays the most); the total is cumulative.

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so there is no shortage of places to spend. This counts cumulatively across everything you buy, and by the time you have bought guns, armor, clothes and car upgrades for the other trophies you will be most of the way there — top it off with a few big purchases at the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more garages tied to the story, which don't count). Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that a new phone app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed, and you buy the garages through that app. All 8 cost $160,000 in total. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4 — and the bank vaults from Maximum Withdrawal pay up to $205,000 each, so the garages are cheap by the time you can afford them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app on your phone. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses): it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location anywhere. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds one or more parking spots for registered vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage click Respray and then Register. Moses initially only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so if you want to keep expenses low, use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
